description:
Shroom powder capsules | Pure chaga extract | Shroom capsule dosage 

Shroom powder capsules  Buy Chaga Extract By Foodsporen®-60 Capsules. In areas such as Siberia, China and Scandinavia, Chaga has an almost divine status. In America, Chaga is called ‘the king of herbs’. Chaga deserves these nicknames twice as far as we’re concerned.

Chaga is not a mushroom as you might know it; as a stem and cap popping up from the surface of the soil. The Chaga grows on trees, and has a very unlikely spongelike form. Chaga is a so-called sclerotium, which is very tough. To make the countless healthy substances from Chaga available to you, Foodsporen uses a high-tech, 3-fold extraction procedure. Part of this procedure is an ultrasound-frequency extraction technique. As a result, the full spectrum of vital substances from the Chaga is present in the extracts of Foodsporen. Each vegetable capsule is richly filled for you with highly concentrated mushroom extract of the Chaga, which is made from the sclerotium. The Chaga mushroom extract capsules contain no less than 30% polysaccharides!

Organic chaga extract | Buy Chaga Extract By Foodsporen®-60 Capsules

Foodsporen only uses the fruiting bodies for each of its products. No fillers or mycelia grown on grains. The Chaga capsules have a high concentration ratio of no less than 12:1.

The capsules come in a sealed Miron glass bottle to ensure longevity it’s constituents. The bottle is UV protective and is consider optimal for the storage of herbs and supplements.

Number of doses:

60 capsules

Best chaga extract product information | Chaga Extract By Foodsporen®-60 Capsules

Per capsule (400mg):

Chaga 12:1 (Inonotus obliquus) fruiting body extract 400mg

Usage:

1 capsule 1 or 2 times daily. Do not take with carbonated drinks or medicines.

Suitable for:

Vegetarians and vegans

Not suitable for:

During pregnancy, breastfeeding and/or an allergy to one of the ingredients. If in doubt, consult your doctor or pharmacist.

Foodsporen® Chaga capsules have been specially developed to supplement your daily diet with the healthy nutrients from the mushrooms mentioned, which are freely absorbable by the body.

Ingredients in Chaga Extract By Foodsporen®-60 Capsules:

Chaga (Inonotus obliquus), microcrystalline cellulose, hypromellose (vegetable capsule)
